items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The MJQ briefly hooked up with Norman Granz and the Jazz at the Philharmonic... he wanted the Quartet on there... we had to do a record on Norman Granz’s label, Verve or whatever it is... we had to put an album on Pablo in order for Norman to release Milt

ctx.x: Michel Sardaby, yeah. A great French pianist.

Right, and I made an album with him and Kenny, and we tried to make an album with Bud Powell, who was over there by that time. And Norman Granz said, “Aww you’ll never heard this!” ‘cause Bud would skip places and it was [a] really mumbo­ jumbo record. So those are my early, recorded experiences, which should have never been. And I made an early record with Dizzy on his DG label with Joe Carroll and Dizzy. Joe was in the band, singing most of these bebop and scat singing…
